name: @rstui-acp/plugin-shm-native
description: OPTIONAL shared-memory transport addon for @rstui-acp/plugin-sdk (ADR 0019). Probed at runtime with graceful fallback to uds/stdio. Offered for transport parity/optionality — NOT speed: ≈ Node-stdio latency (the Node event loop is the floor, by design).
//: The per-platform binaries are optionalDependencies: npm installs ONLY the one matching the host (os/cpu/libc gate in each sub-package), and index.mjs require()s it. None of them being installable is non-fatal — the loader falls back and the SDK drops to uds/stdio.
